sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach are 1st with 22 points from 10 games and have won 7 of their last 5 results (L-W-D-W-W), so despite the recent setback they remain in strong form. They then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October, another opportunity to build on their title credentials against a side struggling near the bottom of the table.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (2nd, 20pts) host Dawley Town on Saturday before facing Wednesfield Community on 10 October—both crucial fixtures in the promotion battle. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19pts) travel to Eccleshall on Saturday, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19pts) visit Wednesfield Community in the opening round of matches. Bilston Town (6th, 17pts) face Foley Meir at home and then visit Crewe, maintaining their push for the top. In the basement, Widnes Town (bottom, 2pts) host Brereton Social and then visit Market Drayton Town—they have won just once all season and face continued struggles. Shawbury United (15th) are in alarming form with six consecutive losses and welcome Barnton before hosting Alsager Town. Telford Town (18th, 6pts) face Cheadle Heath Nomads away then travel to New Mills, while the midfield battle continues with Crewe hosting Allscott Heath and then visiting Bilston Town, and Cheadle Heath Nomads hosting Sandbach's second fixture and visiting Sandbach United. Other mid-table clashes include Brereton Social hosting Widnes Town and Wednesfield Community before visiting Allscott Heath, Barnton hosting Dawley Town, and New Mills entertaining Market Drayton Town before facing Telford Town away.
